standard_prerequisites.name: Glueing of sheaves
standard_prerequisites.use: Underlies the sheaf property of the constructed functor.

core_obligations: Define F(T) as systems (g, {h_U}) over the basis B with the displayed compatibility, and the subfunctors F_W for W in B.
Sheaf property: glue the g_i and then the h_{i,U} componentwise over the covering.
Chart representability: F_W maps isomorphically to Mor(-, X_W) via h_W; build h_U from (rho^W_U)^{-1} and the transition data using conditions (a) and (b).
F_W is contained in F representably by open immersions, and the F_W cover F; conclude with the universal family and uniqueness.
proof_roadmap: Define the functor, verify the sheaf property by componentwise glueing, build the chart systems from conditions (a) and (b), and close with the criterion plus uniqueness.
difficulty_reason: Full functor construction F of compatible systems with sheaf property, chart representability through the basis restriction data, open-immersion and covering checks; the only omission is one bookkeeping verification.
